verdict.rationale: Codegen's own API has one narrow bulk action: a single call that bans all checks for a PR and stops all related agents at once. Beyond that, the evidence shows only per-item operations (running one agent, editing one PR's state). The SDK/API automation is a building block for scripting loops, not a bulk feature, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: general bulk actions across many items (e.g., batch agent creation, multi-PR or multi-issue updates), bulk UI/CLI selection, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Ban all checks for a PR and stop all related agents.
